precert.v: Failure to obtain preauthorization where required results in denial of benefits. Home health and skilled nursing carry a specific penalty instead - a 20% reduction up to a maximum of $500.

ambulance.v: $1,500 Maximum Payment after Deductible, in-network, for ground or air ambulance. Limited to 1 per family per benefit period. Out-of-network pays at the in-network level of benefits if emergent; non-emergent not covered.

dme.v: Durable medical equipment and supplies including prosthetics: $50 copayment after deductible, rental or purchase whichever is least costly. Precertification required if the cost is $500 or more. Limited to 10 visits combined.

er.v: $250 Copayment after Deductible, in-network. Limited to 4 per family per benefit period. Covers facility and professional services. Out-of-network pays at the in-network level of benefits if emergent; non-emergent visits are not covered.

home_health.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined, covering home health aide and respiratory care. Preauthorization required; without it benefits may be reduced by 20% up to a maximum of $500.

mental_health_inpatient.v: $250 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 days. Out-of-network not covered.

mental_health_outpatient.v: $50 copayment after deductible for office services, limited to 10 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

pcp.v: $40 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 12 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

preventive.v: ACA-required preventive services paid at 100% in-network, subject to age, gender and frequency limits. ACA-required services received outside those limits, and other preventive services not required by ACA, are treated the same as any other illness. Out-of-network not covered.

rehab.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined.

rx_brand.v: Preferred brand name and non-preferred brand name drugs are NOT COVERED, both in-network and out-of-network, at retail and by home delivery.

rx_generic.v: Preferred generic drugs: $12 copayment per 30-day retail supply. Out-of-network not covered.

rx_specialty.v: Preferred and non-preferred specialty drugs are NOT COVERED. The document directs members to access patient assistance through ScriptAide, subject to foundational program rules including income requirements.

snf.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined. Preauthorization required; without it benefits may be reduced by 20% up to a maximum of $500.

specialist.v: $50 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 12 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

surgery_outpatient.v: $750 Copayment after Deductible, in-network. Limited to 4 per family per benefit period. Elective surgery is excluded - defined in the document as a procedure planned in advance that can be postponed without immediate harm. Out-of-network not covered.

telehealth.v: $0 copayment through the plan's preferred telemedicine platform, for primary care, mental health and urgent care. Out-of-network not covered.

urgent_care.v: $60 copayment per urgent care visit, waived if referred by Guardianship. Limited to 5 visits. Out-of-network not covered.

xray.v: $75 copayment after deductible, limited to 4 per family per benefit period. Out-of-network not covered.

verification_script.v: A mandatory Post-Close Verification Script exists and must be read on a recorded line before the end of every enrollment call. Its confirmations, in order: (1) the agent will review important details and ask the client to confirm understanding after each statement; (2) this is a Group Limited Medical plan offered to working owners of Population Science Management, providing limited benefits for certain covered services, NOT major medical insurance, and it will not cover all healthcare expenses; (3) the client confirms willingness to share personal health and consumer insights data as a Working Owner in Population Science Management; (4) the plan does not provide full maternity coverage; (5) if the client or a dependent needs ongoing treatment, frequent doctor visits, or continuous management of a medical condition, this plan may not meet those needs; (6) only dependents specifically enrolled that day will be covered and anyone not listed will not have benefits; (7) the pre-existing conditions limitation; (8) the client confirms understanding that the plan provides limited medical benefits, is not major medical coverage, and that they enroll with full awareness of the plan's limits and exclusions; closing with 'Thank you. I will now complete your enrollment.'

moop.v: Max Out of Pocket $9,200 individual / $18,400 family, identical across all four SmartChoice variants.

moop_exclusions.v: CRITICAL. The stated out-of-pocket limit does NOT cap total member cost, because nearly every benefit category carries a hard visit or occurrence limit, and non-covered charges never accumulate. Once a category limit is exhausted the plan pays nothing further for that category regardless of the out-of-pocket limit. The document's own wording is qualified - most covered services, not all.

enrollment_mechanics.v: Enrollment requirements: the applicant must qualify for employment by completing health and eligibility questions; a valid Social Security Number is required for the owner/operator and all dependents; a spousal signature is required at enrollment where applicable; coverage is 1st-of-the-month effective with an enrollment cutoff of the 23rd of the month; all P2 payments are processed on the 20th of the month.

effective_date_rules.v: Coverage effective 6/1/2025. The document warns the deductible year may differ from the plan year and directs the member to confirm with the benefits administrator which deductible period applies.

product_type.v: Limited Medical. The document's own cover title names the plan type.

rx_admin.v: Ventegra is the Pharmacy Benefit Manager. 30-day retail supply runs through Ventegra on an Acute Formulary only. 90-day mail order runs through ScriptCo.

administration.patient_assistance.v: ScriptAide runs the Patient Assistance Program and Patient Importation Program - 866-837-1515. The document states explicitly that ScriptAide is NOT the Pharmacy Benefit Manager.

administration.plan_changes.v: Plan change rules: dependents can be removed at any time but cannot be re-added without a Qualifying Life Event; dependents cannot be added and plans cannot be changed outside of a QLE or Open Enrollment; plan changes outside Open Enrollment require proof of QLE and must be submitted within 60 days. Examples of acceptable QLE proof given include a birth or adoption certificate and a lease or mortgage showing a permanent address change.

administration.precert_vendor.v: GuideCM handles precertification and case management - 866-837-1714, info@guidecm.com

administration.vendor_network.v: The 'Additional Benefits' unit presents Detego Health partner vendors in tabbed panels: Member Advocates (NaviClaim), Pre-Cert and Case Management, Telehealth, Diabetic Solutions, Medical Imaging, and further tabs behind a scroll arrow. NaviClaim is described as assisting members in navigating their benefits plan, answering coverage questions, locating in-network providers and understanding benefits.

administration.vendors.v: Named service vendors: Green Imaging for imaging orders, DiaThrive for diabetic supplies, ConnectDME for durable medical equipment.

benefits.advanced_imaging.v: CT, MRI, MRA, MRS, PET, SPECT and other nuclear medicine: $250 copayment after deductible, limited to 4 per benefit period. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.all_other.v: All other covered services are subject to deductible and coinsurance in-network. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.allergy.v: Testing limited to 2 visits at $50 copayment; shots limited to 10 visits at $25 copayment. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.colorectal_screening.v: Screening benefits start at age 45. Colonoscopy and sigmoidoscopy/proctoscopy/CT colonography screenings paid 100% once every five years; FIT DNA once every three years; fecal occult blood test once per year. Screenings outside the age or frequency limits are treated the same as any other illness.

benefits.diabetic_services.v: Diabetic counselling, education, self-management training and podiatric appliances: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 1 visit. Diabetic supplies are available through DiaThrive only.

benefits.home_infusion.v: $150 copayment after deductible, limited to 12 visits combined, maximum combined with chemotherapy and radiation. Hospital-based treatment is not covered.

benefits.hospice.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined.

benefits.immunizations.v: Paid at 100% in-network both for pediatric up to age 7 and for age 7 and older. Immunizations related to an illness are treated the same as any other illness.

benefits.inpatient_hospital.v: $2,500 copayment after deductible. Limited to 1 per family per benefit period for up to 7 days. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.outpatient_drugs_administered.v: Drugs administered in an outpatient setting such as home or physician office: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined.

benefits.physician_office_services.v: $40 copayment, waived if referred by Guardianship, for office services provided with or without an office visit. Out-of-network not covered.

benefits.prescriptions.formulary.v: The 30-day retail benefit runs on the Ventegra Acute Formulary only.

benefits.prescriptions.home_delivery.v: Preferred generic drugs by 90-day home delivery are supplied through ScriptCo. Brand drugs are not covered by home delivery.

benefits.therapy_manipulations.v: $50 copayment after deductible, limited to 10 visits combined. Treatment limits for physical, occupational and speech therapy do not apply to treatment for mental health or substance use disorders. Evaluations are covered and do not count toward the combined annual limit.

cost_sharing.accumulator_rule.v: In-network and out-of-network deductibles and out-of-pocket limits are separate and do not cross-accumulate. All other limits - days, visits, sessions, dollar amounts - DO cross-accumulate between in and out of network.

cost_sharing.copay_applies_to.v: Copays apply to prescription drugs, urgent care facility, primary care visits and specialist office visits.

cost_sharing.deductible.individual.v: $1,500 in-network per calendar year. Out-of-network: Not Covered.

cost_sharing.moop.includes.v: The out-of-pocket limit includes deductible, coinsurance and copays. Once reached, most covered services are paid at 100% for the remainder of the calendar year.

eligibility.working_owner_model.v: SmartChoice is described as an employer-sponsored GROUP plan provided by Population Science Management (PSM). PSM is a data research and analytics company whose stated mission is empowering individuals to earn money by sharing their personal data and providing Working Owners access to Group Benefit Plans. PSM employs Consumer Data Respondents (CDRs) who provide insights into their health and consumer habits; as a CDR, each person is recognised as a Working Owner of PSM. The material positions this as a solution for working owners, 1099 self-employed and gig-economy workers.

identity.document_class.sec: Introduction - This document is your Summary Plan Description
identity.document_class.v: Summary Plan Description (SPD). The document identifies itself as an SPD and contains an ERISA rights section and COBRA continuation provisions.

limitations.elective_surgery.v: Elective surgery is excluded from the outpatient hospital or facility benefit.

limitations.infertility.v: Services to diagnose infertility and treatment to promote fertility are both NOT COVERED, in-network and out-of-network.

limitations.maternity.v: Pregnancy, maternity and newborn care are NOT COVERED, both in-network and out-of-network. Dependent child pregnancy is specifically noted as not covered. The plan does pay 100% for an initial postpartum depression screening within one year of pregnancy or childbirth.

limitations.out_of_network.v: Out-of-network is shown as Not Covered for every benefit line in the Benefit Summary, with one exception: emergency room and emergency transportation pay at the in-network level of benefits when emergent.

training.curriculum_structure.v: The TalentLMS course 'SmartChoice' (Product category, courseId 202) contains a dedicated unit per variant - SmartChoice 3500, 3000, 2500 and 1500 - plus units titled 'The Working Owner Model', 'Additional Benefits', 'Enrollment Requirements' and 'Test Your Knowledge'. Unit contents were not opened.

training.source_document.v: The per-variant training unit embeds a SIX-PAGE excerpt of the plan document. Cover page matches the Drive document exactly: Limited Medical, deductible $1,500 / $3,000, max out of pocket $9,200 / $18,400, Network First Health, Effective 6/1/2025, with the same note that the deductible year may differ from the plan year.
